Implementation done in worktree fix-37b9; evidence before push:

- scripts/check_import_walk.py: two legs. Installed leg walks every module under the installed rebar package (pkgutil.walk_packages + importlib), all-failures reporting. Scripts leg imports each top-level scripts/*.py in an ISOLATED child process (self-reinvocation --child, scripts dir + CWD stripped from sys.path) so one script's sys.path.insert cannot mask a sibling's missing insert — the exact leak that hid the alert_dedup escape (spinal-grayish-perch).
- Skip tables, both explicit + reasoned: EXPECTED_OPTIONAL = rebar._mcp_auth (mcp, [mcp]), rebar.opcert_service.app + rebar.review_bot.app (fastapi, [reviewbot]) — each still ATTEMPTED, recorded as skip only when ModuleNotFoundError.name == declared dep AND the dep is absent. SCRIPTS_SKIPS = t5c_calibrate.py (unguarded top-level execution running real LLM calls at import — importing it is unsafe; no other script has import-time side effects, verified by AST scan + empirical run).
- Base-wheel clean venv run: installed leg 0 failed / 3 skipped / 451 passed; scripts leg 0 failed / 1 skipped / 58 passed; exit 0.
- Regression proof: (a) RED-first pytest suite (tests/scripts/test_check_import_walk.py, 11 tests) recreating the pre-fix bare-sibling-import shape — caught, and NOT masked by an earlier-sorted inserting sibling; synthetic package with two broken modules — BOTH reported (not fail-fast). (b) Live demo: two broken modules injected into the installed wheel copy -> walk reports both, exit 1.
- Wiring: one invocation added to the wheel-probe step of .github/workflows/_artifact-probe.yml; make import-walk + direct invocation locally (portability); documented in docs/releasing.md.
- Gates: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (mypy 624 files), complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0, make import-walk PASS in the dev venv (mcp present -> _mcp_auth attempted and passing, proving the mechanism only skips while the dep is absent).
